components.extended_description: Store Pythoine is Suite Pythoine’s optional headless repository-discovery and rich-content backend. Suite owns trusted application identity, installed state, App Pages and managed installation; Store checks only Suite-authorised GitHub repositories and publishes a normalized local snapshot for Suite’s integrated Store frontend.
highlights: Headless backend with Suite Pythoine as the only user-facing Store interface
Application versions are declared by each authorised application repository, not a central Store version ledger
Online refresh is explicit; normal Store browsing remains local and offline
components.release_notes: 0.0.4 replaces the central online version catalogue with bounded checks of GitHub repositories authorised by Suite Pythoine. The local store-content.json remains a generated/offline snapshot and enrichment contract rather than version authority.
